official_name_basis: ChatGPTプラグイン詳細画面の表示名
original_description: Mapflyover makes cinematic map flyover videos. Connected to ChatGPT, it builds complete map animation videos from your words: describe a journey or paste a script and Mapflyover creates the project, flies a cinematic 3D camera between the places, highlights and fills countries (including with their flags), draws animated routes, generates narration and burns in timed captions. Projects stay fully editable in the Mapflyover web editor.
